title: New Orleans True Crime Ghost Hunt and Tour
includes: Curated guide to all things NOLA by our wonderful staff!
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us on an immersive walking tour, exploring the crimes committed throughout New Orleans’ 300 plus years and the spirits that have lingered through time. We will empower you to search for these spirits, as you assist us on our journey to understand more about the paranormal in our City. 

Begin your journey at Witches Brew Gallery & Haunted Sanctuary, where you will be given a link to download an app to assist you with our collective ghost hunt. You are now one of our ghost hunters, helping us better define the spirits that live among us.
